svg.aria-label: The strip's first triangle seen from +Z, with +X to the right and +Y up: vertex 0 at the root's left edge, vertex 1 at the root's right edge, vertex 2 one step up on the left edge. Going 0, 1, 2 and back to 0 turns counter-clockwise, and the normal points out of the page, toward you.
